result:
I reviewed questions 21–30 and wrote the batch file. All 10 official answers match the official answer PDF, and I solved each question myself and got the same answer.

- **Records:** 10
- **Approved:** 10
- **Held:** 0
- **Output:** `docs/evidence/fp2-2026-may-practical/solutions-batch-03.json`

**Text extraction problems (answers not affected):**
- **Q23, Q24, Q26:** Labels from the diagrams were flattened into plain text and left, out of order, at the end of the extracted question text. The Q26 area label also came out as "m2" instead of "㎡".
- **Q28, Q29:** The cash-flow tables came out one cell per line, so the text alone doesn't show which year each value belongs to.

In every case the figure images (`q23-1.webp`, `q28-1`〜`q28-3`, and the others) match the official PDF, so the questions still work. The flattened labels could be stripped from the text later.

**Q25:** The question never states the 20-year marriage requirement for the spouse deduction. I noted this and calculated assuming the requirement is met, because the question tells you to apply the deduction.

**Government reference URLs:** I only listed pages I actually opened:
- National Tax Agency answers No.1211-1, 1234, 2075, 4114 and 4452.
- The Civil Code on e-gov. I confirmed Articles 887, 939, 1037–1039, 1041 and 1042 in the full law text downloaded from the e-gov API.
- The JASSO page (`jasso.go.jp`) for Q30. JASSO is an independent administrative agency, not a ministry, so drop it if your standard is strictly ministries and agencies.

**No URL:**
- **Q26:** The National Tax Agency valuation-circular page returned a 404.
- **Q28, Q29:** These are pure calculations with no law behind them.

I didn't change any application code or data files, and I didn't use subagents.
